comment: ATTACK STYLES. A style is a named list of FRAMES (strokes.h "AN ATTACK IS A LIST OF FRAMES"). Every frame is the same kind of thing: where the weapon TIP is when the frame ends (az/el radians, reach a band position), what that is measured FROM ("target" = 0/0 points at what is attacked, the default; "body" = the wielder's own facing), ticks, pacing ("ease": linear, a curve, or "chase" + "chaseRate"), "cuts" (the damage sweep is live), "lean" (follow / hold / left / right: which side of the tip the hand is on), "wrist" (0..1 blade alignment), "torsoTwist"/"torsoPitch" (omit = global melee.*), and "joints" (per-joint smoothing while the frame runs). The cutting frames are one run: frames before it are the windup (the aim locks at its end), frames after it are the return; "release" ticks then hand the arm back. Edit in the tuner's Attacks lane.
player_notes: PLAYER OVERRIDES. A style's optional `player` block holds what differs when the PLAYER swings it: its own `frames` (a full list — it replaces the base's), `release`, `jitter` (0 on purpose: a strike goes exactly where it was flicked), `ease`. The flick compasses (`player`, `playerDagger`, `playerUnarmed`) name base styles and use the player copy when one exists.
notes: ANGLES ARE RADIANS in the wielder's facing basis: azimuth 0 is straight ahead (or straight at the target, for a target-measured frame) and positive is the wielder's right; elevation 0 is level, positive up. REACH is a position in the arm's own reach band: 0 = the neutral 0.60, +1 out, -1 in. The tuner shows degrees.

clickRepeat.//: A short blade's stab repeats: after this style, a plain (unflicked) click with the same hand throws it again instead of the neutral alternate, and it chains (starts in the recover, melee.chainWindupRate faster). Only for the weapon classes listed.

playerUnarmed.//: Fists throw the SAME directional strikes as a weapon (Mob::ArmForStyle arms the empty hand's fist for a held style), each in its own `forms.unarmed` poses (seeded 2026-09-27 from the sword's). punch_r / punch_l / punch_thrust / hook_r are DEPRECATED and kept only for the gates that name them.

styles.//: UNARMED, FROM HERE DOWN (docs/PLAN_impact_unarmed.md §5). Every one of these names a `weapon` -- a natural weapon on the creature's own rig (mob.h MobNaturalWeaponDef) rather than the default "held" -- and StyleUsable refuses it on a body that has not got that part, so a one-armed creature's repertoire shrinks by itself. The punches are all `fallback: true`: a duelist lists them beside its cuts, never draws one while a sword is in its fist, and throws nothing else once disarmed. The zombie's bites are NOT fallback, because biting is what it does. Numbers are starting points; the tuner's Attacks lane is where they get finished.
styles.name: punch_r
styles.label: Straight right

styles.name: snake_strike
styles.label: Snake strike
styles.//: THE SNAKE'S ONE STYLE (assets/mobs/snake.json). The windup is the COIL: `clip` plays the sidecar's `snake_strike`, an override on the four neck segments that draws them back into an S with the head raised (the slither yields those segments to it, Mob::ApplySlither). The lunge fires at the CUT, not the windup -- the coil is the telegraph and the strike is the release -- and stays low (rise 0.3 m/s) because a snake strikes along the ground. It goes for the legs: the snake is prone by nature, so `targetProne` is the table it actually draws from -- narrowed by the engine to what a body lying on the ground can rise to (MobSystem::PickTargetLimb reachHeight: its own height and a voxel), which on a standing victim is the feet.

styles.name: punch_thrust
styles.label: Two-handed drive
styles.//: Player-only unarmed thrust (down flick). The deepest chamber and the longest drive in the block, and almost no azimuth — it is the punch you throw with your weight behind it.
